hooks.rewakeMessage: Uncommitted changes detected and SESSION-HANDOFF.md is stale. Write SESSION-HANDOFF.md now before the session ends.
hooks.command: $hasChanges = git diff --name-only HEAD 2>$null; $hasUntracked = git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>$null | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'SESSION-HANDOFF' }; if ($hasChanges -or $hasUntracked) { $handoff = 'E:\Freelance\Github\projects\peoplehub\SESSION-HANDOFF.md'; $needsUpdate = $true; if (Test-Path $handoff) { $age = (Get-Date) - (Get-Item $handoff).LastWriteTime; if ($age.TotalMinutes -lt 30) { $needsUpdate = $false } }; if ($needsUpdate) { exit 2 } }; exit 0
